$comment: §32.5 cross-lingual recall starter set. 50 HI↔EN pairs across the 11 §32.4 types. Each pair is ONE memory written twice; the gate stores the Hindi side and queries with the English side, and passes at recall@1 ≥ 0.85. §32.5's full gate is 500 pairs across HI↔EN↔TA at the W3 bake-off — this is the starter set that keeps the harness honest until then.
